description: Total price of a stay (check_in and check_out) or of a time slot (date, start_time, end_time) at one listing, as its page shows it. Answers that the dates are not available when they are taken. A quote is not a booking.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (listings booked by nights).

date.description: Day of the time slot, YYYY-MM-DD (listings booked by time slots).

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and page links. Default en.

name: get_quote
title: Get a price quote
